_comment: #350 fix wave. player_room_loop's NIGHT leg, installed mid-run into the manual slot and reloaded via the pause->Load idiom (thread_lattice_loop precedent). Identical to player_room_start EXCEPT: the lease is already bought (room_purchased, gold spent to 0), the player STANDS in the leased room at its arrival cell (4,5), and actions_since_sleep is 901 -- one past moods.json meta.phase_thresholds.night (900), so the room loads at NIGHT with its sconce at full energy. Reaching night by walking would cost 900 real actions; this is the cheap, deterministic way to put a human eye on the only phase where a missing mood row is loud. rng_state is seed 9's derived state (inert -- no fight resolves here); version 8.
